nodes.description: At the raw `ut8p_bw (buf + 1)` sink, the first rec_size-byte pointer `buf + 1` is at or past the one-past-end pointer `buf + length`, so the very first byte consumed by the macro is outside the materialized heap buffer.
nodes.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `header_use.rec_size_field_ptr >= header_use.buf_end_ptr`.

edges.description: The exact heap-buffer base pointer materialized by `r_buf_data (b, &length)` is reused unchanged as the base of the raw `ut8p_bw (buf + 1)` header read.
edges.evidence: In the vulnerable original case, `whole_buf_state.buf_ptr == header_use.buf_ptr`.

root_cause_criterion.description: Once `check_buffer` materializes the whole input with `const ut8 *buf = r_buf_data (b, &length);`, it must establish that the fixed 4-byte OMF header exists (`length >= 4`) before interpreting `buf + 1` and `buf + 3` as header fields. The vulnerable original never proves that lower bound before the raw reads.
